competition.title: Software Internship
competition.details:
The Entrepreneurship Network is hiring for Software Internship

About the Company

The Entrepreneurship Network supports an environment where entrepreneurial ideas, collaboration, and practical learning can grow. The team is seeking a Software Intern to contribute to technology work while developing hands-on experience in an innovation-focused setting. This remote internship is intended for freshers interested in beginning their journey in the Information Technology industry.

Responsibilities

  • Assist with software development tasks and contribute to assigned technical projects.
  • Work with team members to understand requirements, discuss solutions, and deliver updates.
  • Write clear, maintainable code and help review or improve existing implementations.
  • Test features, investigate issues, and document findings and progress.
  • Stay engaged with feedback and apply it to improve the quality of project work.

Requirements

  • Suitable for fresher candidates starting their careers in software and information technology.
  • Interest in software development and a willingness to learn new tools and practices.
  • Good communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work responsibly in a remote team environment and manage assigned tasks.

This is a three-month, paid internship with a stipend of ₹1,000. The position is remote and offers freshers an opportunity to build practical experience through assigned software work.
